rulings.answer: No, you can't.  You can place 1 [Sanzomon], 1 [Gokuumon], or 1 [Cho-Hakkaimon] under this card.
rulings.question: Can I place 1 each of [Sanzomon], [Gokuumon], and [Cho-Hakkaimon] for this card's DigiXros requirements?

rulings.answer: No, you can't. The "if DigiXrosing" part of the effect can only activate when DigiXrosing.
rulings.question: If DigiXrosing when this card would be played, can I also activate the part after "if DigiXrosing" in this card's [On Play] [When Attacking] effect when this Digimon attacks?
Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Attacking] effect or inherited effect to give 1 of my Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞?

rulings.answer: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
rulings.question: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area" mean, exactly?

rulings.answer: Yes, it triggers.  Because a Digimon also leaves the battle area when it's placed in digivolution cards for a DigiXros, the effect triggers and activates.
rulings.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger when this card is in the battle area and would be placed in another Digimon’s digivolution cards for a DigiXros?

rulings.answer: No, it can't.  You must choose all of the cards to place when you declare the DigiXros. After choosing them, the chosen cards are placed under the card to DigiXros. This card's [All Turns] effect triggers and activates when the chosen cards would be placed, so after activation has occurred, you can't re-do your choices for the cards to place for the DigiXros.
rulings.question: I chose this card as a target for a DigiXros. Then, I used this card's [All Turns] effect to return a yellow Digimon card to the hand. At such times, can the card returned to the hand be placed for the DigiXros?
